type.provenance: This bill would prohibit, beginning January 1, 2025, a person or entity from manufacturing, selling, delivering, holding, or offering for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances PFAS, as defined.

who.provenance: no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product

action.provenance: manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce

intentionally_added.provenance: intentionally added PFAS means either of the following: PFAS chemicals that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product
